events: 🎟️ Into the cup quarter-final, drawn against Levante.

aiHeadlines: 🧱 Nobody is harder to score on than Real Madrid: 3 conceded all season.
📊 Real Sociedad top the La Liga on 16 points after 6 rounds.
🧱 Nobody is harder to score on than Real Sociedad: 2 conceded all season.

📊 Levante top the La Liga on 9 points after 3 rounds.
⏰ Deadline day is done. The window is shut until January.
⏳ Deadline week. Any business left undone stays undone until the next window.
🛡️ Torvald Merrion has gone to Espanyol unanswered. Real Madrid need a new defence coach.

boardObjectives.label: Win the La Liga and Copa del Rey double
Have 8 players from Spain in the squad
Have 5 players aged 30 or over in the squad

inbox.text: International break: the window runs 21 Sep to 6 Oct, and the calendar here keeps your fixtures going through it, so they went straight after your last game. Away with their countries (France: Kylian Mbappé, Aurélien Tchouaméni, Eduardo Camavinga and Ibrahima Konaté; Brazil: Vinicius Junior, Rodrygo and Endrick; England: Jude Bellingham and Trent Alexander-Arnold; Uruguay: Federico Valverde; Türkiye: Arda Güler; Cote d'Ivoire: Yan Diomande; Spain: Dean Huijsen, Álvaro Carreras and Marc Cucurella; Morocco: Brahim Díaz; Portugal: Bernardo Silva; Netherlands: Denzel Dumfries; Ukraine: Andriy Lunin). They are back for the Eibar game. Kylian Mbappé, Vinicius Junior, Jude Bellingham, Federico Valverde, Arda Güler, Aurélien Tchouaméni, Yan Diomande, Álvaro Carreras, Rodrygo, Bernardo Silva and Andriy Lunin started for their countries, the rest mostly watched from the bench. The long trips hurt most. Your assistant wants to know: start them against Eibar, or rest the spent ones for that one game?

options.label: Rest the ones who are spent

inbox.resolved: That game has been and gone.

inbox.text: One of your defenders challenged a fan who criticized him to a race. The fan won. It is everywhere.

options.label: Sign the fan for the youth team

inbox.text: Aurélien Tchouaméni has asked for a meeting about his place in the side. He is training well and he does not think the teamsheet reflects it.
A reporter from the local paper is running a piece on whether this squad is good enough for what the board have asked of you. He wants a line from you before it goes out.

pending.text: Aurélien Tchouaméni has started 0 of the last 7. Is he finished at this club?

options.label: He is still my player
options.line: You backed him in front of everybody. He will run through a wall on Saturday.

options.label: He has to earn it back
options.line: Standards, in public. Ten of them heard it as a warning and one heard it as a demotion.

options.label: You would have to ask him
options.line: A shrug and a next question. He was not wounded by it and nobody else was impressed either.

decisions.text: The board have £200k spare this quarter and want to know where you want it. They will put it in the transfer pot if you ask, and they would read holding it back as a careful manager.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
